name: acceptance-gate
description: Acceptance gate for AI-generated features. Normalizes requirements into acceptance contracts, generates eval cases, renders decision cards and evidence pages, records gate decisions (approve/signoff), reports gate metrics, verifies evidence, and enforces evidence-backed verdicts with runtime hooks when available plus CI re-checks. v1.22 adds the rules ledger to pre-merge-check.sh: clean must be PROVEN — every rule block records ran/declared-off through one ledger_mark chokepoint against a fixed EXPECTED list, a machine-readable summary line (pre-merge-check: rules ran= declared-off= expected=) whose expected count is derived from EXPECTED rather than from the running totals, and any ledger mismatch is an internal-gate error (exit 2). This catches silently-skipped rule blocks that no input-validation blacklist could enumerate. v1.22.1 hardening wave: declared-but-unusable scope/filter values now exit 2 as a class (empty --base/--slug, typo'd or /-containing slug filters, PRE_MERGE_BASE set-but-empty with +x set-detection, declared base on a git-less root), an explicit --base still overrides an empty env var, VIOLATION [scope] prints on stdout like every other VIOLATION. (Repo-internal maintenance tooling also hardened — sync-plugin-packages.sh rejects extra argv — but that script ships only in the kit repo, not in this package.)

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-backed acceptance gate for AI-generated features
interface.longDescription: Use Acceptance Gate to turn feature requests into acceptance contracts, generate evals, render decision cards and evidence pages, verify machine evidence, and block unsupported PASS verdicts with runtime hooks when available plus CI re-checks.
